verdict.strongest_covered_cluster: The AI-to-human operational flow is strongest: routine routing, real-time AI service, read-only facts, authorized self-service, all three transfer triggers, complete warm-transfer payload, wait-target handling, and callback scheduling are represented.
verdict.most_consequential_gap: The customer-lookup greeting logic is incomplete: there is no failed/unmatched branch or generic greeting, and the successful-match account-context/personalized-greeting behavior is only partially implied.
verdict.coverage_summary: Weighted coverage is 42.5 of 48.0 (P = 0.8854). Most of the call flow, handoff, callback, recording/transcription, and governance loop is covered. The raw coverage maps to 7, but absent system-defining requirement R4 applies the RC cap of 6.
